svg.title: Conway's law
svg.desc: A food delivery app is built by a web team, a backend team, and a mobile team, so it has a web app, a mobile app, and one big API with web and mobile endpoints over one Postgres database, and a new feature needs all three teams and about 6 weeks. The engineers are reshuffled into ordering, restaurant, and courier teams, and the code follows: three services, each with its own database, with APIs exactly where the teams talk. The next ordering feature needs one team and 2 weeks.
svg.text: Every API sits right under a conversation
Schedule order feature: 3 teams, about 6 weeks
Every API still sits under a conversation
The seams land where the teams talk. Reorganize the teams and they move.
